map.拖延症评估量表基于一般拖延行为量表(GPS)改编，通过10个常见拖延场景的自我评: The Procrastination Assessment Scale is adapted from the General Procrastination Scale (GPS) and quantifies procrastination through self-rating on 10 common procrastination scenarios. Please answer based on what actually happened in the last 2 weeks.
map.本工具改编一般拖延行为量表（GPS）思路，用 10 个常见拖延场景评估「最近 2: This tool follows the approach of the General Procrastination Scale (GPS), using 10 common procrastination scenarios to assess your behavioural tendency over the "past 2 weeks". Each item is rated 0-4 by frequency (never → always). Adding the 10 items gives a total of 0-40: the higher the score, the heavier the procrastination. Everything runs in the browser and no answer is uploaded.
map.点选项文字即可作答，也可用键盘 1–5 / ← →: Click the option text to answer; you can also use keys 1-5 / ← →
map.题号速览（点任意题号可回去改答案）: Question number overview (click any number to go back and change that answer)
map.请回顾「最近 2 周」的真实情况，不要选理想状态或偶尔一次的表现: Look back at what really happened in the "past 2 weeks"; do not choose how you wish things were or how you behaved once in a while
map.每题 5 档从「从不」到「总是」，拿不准就选最接近的一档: Each question has 5 levels from "never" to "always"; if unsure, pick the closest one
map.本评估为自评参考，分数高只说明拖延倾向明显，不构成临床诊断: This is a self-rating reference; a high score only means the procrastination tendency is clear and is not a clinical diagnosis
map.答题进度仅保存在本机浏览器，点「重新测试」即可清空，数据不会上传: Your progress is stored only in this local browser. Click "Restart test" to clear it; no data is uploaded
map.请根据最近2周的真实情况作答，不要选择理想状态: Please answer based on what actually happened in the last 2 weeks, not on how you wish things were
map.拖延症评分仅供参考，不构成临床诊断: The procrastination score is for reference only and is not a clinical diagnosis
map.10分以下无明显拖延 11-20轻度 21-30中度 31-40重度: Below 10 no obvious procrastination, 11-20 mild, 21-30 moderate, 31-40 severe
map.重度拖延且影响日常功能时建议寻求专业帮助: If severe procrastination is affecting daily functioning, consider seeking professional help
map.工作拖延自查：总把重要任务拖到最后一刻、靠 deadline 救命时，用它量化拖: Work procrastination self-check: when you keep pushing important tasks to the last minute and survive on deadlines, use it to quantify how often that happens.
map.学业拖延：学生党可用来识别「明明想学却一直刷手机」的模式，找到触发点。: Study procrastination: students can use it to spot the "I wanted to study but kept scrolling my phone" pattern and find its trigger.
map.改善前后对照：用了时间管理或番茄钟后，隔月再测看分数是否下降。: Before and after comparison: after using time management or the Pomodoro technique, retest a month later and see whether the score drops.
map.拖延往往源于对任务的焦虑、完美主义或目标模糊，而非单纯的懒惰。本题 10 题覆盖: Procrastination usually stems from anxiety about the task, perfectionism or an unclear goal rather than plain laziness. These 10 items cover typical patterns such as "avoidance, last-minute work and self-blame", helping you tell an ability problem from an emotional one.
map.分数高就一定是拖延症吗？: Does a high score mean I definitely have procrastination disorder?
map.本题是自评筛查，提示拖延频率偏高；真正影响功能的「拖延症」需结合生活受损程度判断: This is a self-rating screen that flags a high procrastination frequency; real "procrastination disorder" that impairs functioning has to be judged together with how much your life is damaged, so do not force a label on yourself.
map.把大任务拆小、降低启动门槛、用「5 分钟先开始」技巧，都比靠意志力硬抗更有效。: Breaking big tasks into small pieces, lowering the threshold to start, and using the "just start for 5 minutes" technique all work better than forcing yourself through sheer willpower.
